metadata.description: Verified, production-tested Agent Skills for Houdini, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, After Effects and Premiere Pro

plugins.name: houdini
plugins.description: Houdini through MCP: POP particles, pyro in moving containers, VDB surfacing, flipbooks and GL passes, readable networks, Alembic and VDB export for Cinema 4D

plugins.name: cinema4d
plugins.description: Cinema 4D through MCP and c4dpy: Redshift node materials and test renders, native particles, Alembic, rigs, takes, Motion Tracker, render previews

plugins.name: unreal
plugins.description: Unreal Engine 5.8 through Epic's Unreal MCP plugin and Python: materials, Level Sequences and Movie Render Queue, LED volume rigs, editor tools, content clean-up, Ultra Dynamic Sky

plugins.name: adobe
plugins.description: After Effects and Premiere Pro without MCP, through small file-based CEP bridges, plus After Effects scripting from a macOS shell

plugins.name: production
plugins.description: App-independent helpers: voice-over word timings in frames, and per-production notes kept between sessions
